title: Appointment Dates: Booking Window Terms of Repair Estimates & Appointments
content:
### Terms

Every Repair Estimates & Appointments appointment date, whether set at booking or by a reschedule, must sit inside the estimate type's booking window measured from the day the request is made:

- **Lead time.** The request is made no later than the estimate type's minimum booking lead days before the appointment date.
- **Horizon.** The request is made no earlier than the estimate type's maximum booking horizon days before the appointment date.
- **Counting.** Days are calendar days: the deadline is the appointment date minus the stated number of days, and a request made on that deadline date is in time.
- **Same day and weekends.** A same-day appointment is possible only where the estimate type allows same-day booking, and a Saturday or Sunday appointment only where it offers weekend appointments.
- **Photo Estimate.** A Photo Estimate has no visit: its appointment date is the request date itself.
- **Key drop.** Where the estimate type allows the evening-before key drop, a vehicle left in the key drop the evening before counts as arriving at the appointment start.

Both tests are read against the appointment date recorded on the booking concerned; for a reschedule the window is counted from the reschedule request date.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical appointment on day D)

| Estimate type (lead / horizon) | Request on | Lead test | Horizon test |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scheduled Estimate (1 / 30) | D minus 1 | In time (on the deadline date) | In time |
| Scheduled Estimate (1 / 30) | D | Not in time | — |
| Scheduled Estimate (1 / 30) | D minus 30 | In time | In time (on the horizon date) |
| Scheduled Estimate (1 / 30) | D minus 31 | In time | Too early |
| Mobile Estimate (2 / 21) | D minus 2 | In time | In time |
| Mobile Estimate (2 / 21) | D minus 1 | Not in time | — |

A Drive-In Estimate requested on day D for day D passes the lead test (0 days) and is possible because that type allows same-day booking; a Mobile Estimate cannot be set for a Saturday or a Sunday, whatever the lead.
